svg.title: Along PT23, Nhd+1 →∞makes 8/N ≤r eventually, and Nh5d+4 →∞gives the second vanishing term. Consequently the same reader recovers PT26 for each fixed power required by a finite jet. If a fixed finite stencil calculation uses P t λtEN(at) with constant coefficients and bounded rescaling degree, the finite sum of these bounds proves its return limit with the same schedule, after taking the maximum of finitely many thresholds. This transports the actual torus-minus-cover cancellation used for arbitrary finite chart functionals.
